get_fsm_cache: get the Redis or default Django cache backend for FSM operations with memoized result
get_current_state_value: get the current state string for a Django model entity with cached lookup and fallback to database query
transition_state: transition a Django model entity to a new state with optimistic caching lock, INSERT-only audit trail, and write-through cache
get_state_history: retrieve the complete ordered state history for a Django model entity from the state registry
execute_transition: execute a named registered state transition on an entity through the declarative transition executor
